english.text: Awed by the vision and the voice divine / ('twas no mere dream; their very looks I knew, / I saw the fillets round their temples twine, / and clammy sweat did all my limbs bedew) / forthwith, upstarting, from the couch I flew, / and hands and voice together raised in prayer, / and wine unmixt upon the altars threw. / This done, to old Anchises I repair, / pleased with the rites fulfilled, and all the tale declare.

jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 ging2 zoeng6 tung4 san4 sing3 ge3 sing1 jam1 gam2 dou3 ging3 wai3 / （m4 hai6 daan1 seon4 ge3 mung6；ngo5 zi1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ngoi6 biu2， / ngo5 gin3 dou2 jyu4 lau5 wai4 zyu6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 taai3 joeng4 jyut6， / tung4 maai4 sap1 sap1 ge3 hon6 seoi2 ling6 ngo5 so2 jau5 sei3 zi1 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6） / zik1 hak1 hoi1 ci2，ngo5 jau4 go3 so1 faa2 dou6 fei1 zo2 ceot1 lai4， / tung4 soeng1 sau2 tung4 sing1 jam1 jat1 cai4 geoi2 hei2 kei4 tou2， / tung4 zau2 mei6 wan6 hap6 hai2 zai3 taan4 soeng6 min6 paau1 zo2 / ni1 gin6 si6 jyun4 sing4 zo2，ngo5 sau1 fuk6 zo2 bei2 on1 gei1 sak1 si1， / hou2 mun5 ji3 ji4 sik1 ji5 ging1 jyun4 sing4 zo2，tung4 maai4 syun1 bou3 saai3 so2 jau5 ge3 gu3 si6。
text: 我對呢個景象同神聖嘅聲音感到敬畏 / （唔係單純嘅夢；我知道佢哋嘅外表， / 我見到魚柳圍住佢哋嘅太陽穴， / 同埋濕濕嘅汗水令我所有四肢都瞓唔着） / 即刻開始，我由個梳化度飛咗出嚟， / 同雙手同聲音一齊舉起祈禱， / 同酒未混合喺祭壇上面拋咗 / 呢件事完成咗，我修復咗畀安基塞斯， / 好滿意儀式已經完成咗，同埋宣布晒所有嘅故事。
